_comment: SAMPLE reviews used as placeholders until real customer reviews are collected. Each one is marked sample:true and shown with a 'Sample review' label. Remove the sample flag and the label only for genuine reviews.

reviews.name: Meera K.
reviews.text: My daughter (4) asked for her book every night for a week. Seeing her own face and her grandma on the pages made her giggle every time.

reviews.name: Rohan S.
reviews.text: Ordered the hardcover as a 7th birthday present. The photos were clear, the story felt personal, and the printing looked lovely.

reviews.name: Aisha M.
reviews.text: Easy to use on my phone. The free preview let me check every page before I paid, which made the decision simple.

reviews.name: Tom & Lisa R.
reviews.text: Our 9-year-old is now the hero of a space comic. Loved the speech bubbles and the end page with the whole family.

reviews.name: Sunita P.
reviews.text: Uploading the photos was quick and the consent step felt reassuring. I'd love more story choices, so I'm hoping those are coming.

reviews.name: James O.
reviews.text: Arrived well packed and in good time. Ordering a second one for the cousins next month.
